adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in packages/core/EventManager.ts around line 542, the code shows that when `reference.credentialId` is falsy (the else branch at line 509-515), it filters credentials by type matching `reference.type` and then pushes updateEvent for each credential. This is the legacy fallback behavior. The finding correctly identifies that for each calendar reference without a credentialId, the code iterates through all credentials of that type and calls updateEvent for each one. If there are multiple calendar references (N) and multiple credentials of the same type (M), this would result in N×M update calls. This is indeed a potential bug where legacy bookings without credentialId could cause duplicate calendar operations. The diff shows this pattern clearly in the nested loops structure.
